mo_ta_cong_viec:
Introduction
Join Deliveree as a Software Engineer and build scalable, innovative solutions that drive operational growth and shape the future of logistics. At Deliveree, you will develop scalable tools and applications that drive operational growth and help transform the logistics industry.
As a Software Engineer, you will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and continuously improve high-quality operational systems. You will also leverage the latest AI technologies, including AI-assisted development, automation, and intelligent coding tools, to improve productivity, accelerate delivery, and enhance software quality.
This is a challenging and rewarding opportunity to grow in a fast-paced technology environment, strengthen your engineering capabilities, and make a meaningful impact on the future of logistics. Join us and bring your skills, curiosity, and passion for technology.
Responsibilities
● Develop, and maintain software applications and tools that support Deliveree's operational processes.
● Use AI-assisted and agentic coding tools to accelerate development, explore solutions, generate tests, troubleshoot issues, and improve engineering productivity.
● Review, validate, and refine AI-generated code to ensure correctness, security, maintainability, and alignment with engineering standards.
● Work with Product, Data, Business,... teams on product logic to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
● Stay up-to-date with the latest software development technologies and trends.
● Contribute to the continuous improvement of Deliveree's technology stack and infrastructure.
yeu_cau:
Your Skills and Experience
● 1–3 years of experience in software engineering or related roles.
● Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
● Experience with AWS or other major cloud platforms such as GCP.
● Experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and familiarity with NoSQL solutions.
● Experience using AI coding tools, coding agents, or large language models as part of the software development lifecycle.
● Ability to write clear requirements, technical instructions, and prompts that enable AI coding agents to produce reliable outputs.
● Intermediate English communication skills
● Logical thinking, ability to multi-task with different departments, and work independently under tight deadlines.
● Willingness to learn new technologies and solve problems using cutting-edge tools.
